owner: Konza Technopolis Development Authority (KoTDA); Huawei Cloud Stack technology partner
notes: Uptime Institute lists Konza National Data Center at Konza Technopolis for KoTDA, and Huawei says Konza deployed a Tier-III standards data center using Huawei Cloud Stack. Konza's statutory/planning materials show parts of the Konza planning zone fall within Kajiado County, although some press descriptions place the data-centre phase at Konza/Machakos County; included for Kajiado with that boundary caveat. No public MW capacity found.
